verdict.rationale: Better Auth's homepage claims "Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation," which points to a first-party delegated-token capability for agents. That is only a one-line marketing mention with no docs on how agents get user-consented, short-lived tokens for third-party APIs. The MCP plugin makes your app an authorization server for MCP clients, not a vault for outbound third-party tokens, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented token-vault or exchange flow for third-party provider tokens, user consent and scoping details, short-lived token issuance and refresh semantics, agent tool-call usage docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent obtain short-lived, user-consented tokens for third-party APIs (token vault/exchange) so tool calls run under the user's delegated authority

citations.quote: Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation.
